name: Miyu Shina
source:
Miyu is one of the four main girls in Midnight Moon.

FUN FACTS:

-Miyu was originally going to be a tsundere girl named Tsuki. However, SpringingTraps scrapped this idea since it was a little too similar to [url=/c64505]Natsuki[/url] from Doki Doki Literature Club, along with Spring's own personal distaste for tsundere girls.

-Her nerdy, gamer girl personality was heavily inspired by Mio from Crush Crush. 

-Spring didn't have access to Google Translate when he was designing Miyu's character, so he instead skimmed through last names of characters from Yandere Simulator, choosing that as one of the names. He eventually decided on Saki. Thus, Miyu's name is the only one of the group without any traditional meaning.
